lines: As we stepped into that altar...
...we found ourselves within a sorcerer's study.
The ruins we were in previously were now nowhere to be seen.
It was a small room, about five square meters, but each wall was completely lined with bookshelves.
And in the center of the study was a desk, stacked with books and notes.
There were also flasks connected by thin pipes that looked like they were used in magic experiments of some kind.
Chevalier
Not a bad collection. Though I don't think their taste in books matches Chevalier's.
Kirara
Never mind that, where'd they go!? I don't see them anywhere!
Indeed, the Guardian who'd lured us into this room was nowhere to be found.
From the looks of it, there didn't appear to be any passages other than the door we'd just entered.
Sorcerer
Welcome to my humble abode.
Suddenly, a man appeared in the center of the room.
Kirara
Kirara-senpai instantly tried to attack him, but Annreed held her back.
Annreed
This is illusionary magic. Like a holographic image left behind.
Kirara
You mean like a voice mail?
Annreed
Well, something like that.
Me
Is this old man the master of this place...?
He was wearing a silk hat, a monocle, and an Inverness coat, looking like an elderly European gentleman.
His mechanical cane and monocle didn't match the image of a sorcerer in my head.
Me
Do you know him, Chevalier?
Chevalier
Mm-hm-hm. Why don't we hear what he has to say first?
As Chevalier said so, the old man began to speak as if he had been waiting patiently despite being a mere illusion.
Valdo Bardo
I am Valdo Bardo.
Valdo Bardo
The fact that you are seeing this illusion means that you are scoundrels whom I do not recall inviting.
Valdo Bardo
Still, I welcome you.
Valdo Bardo
I am impressed that you were able to overcome the obstruction of my guardian, Draugr August, and reach this room.
Valdo Bardo
I would like to hire you as mercenaries for your abilities. You shall be well compensated, of course.
With that, the illusion of Valdo showed a trunk filled with wads of bills.
There had to be tens of thousands worth inside.
That was quite the sum for hiring some simple mercenaries.
Naturally, he would also demand a level of work befitting that lofty price tag.
Valdo Bardo
I have devoted my life to a certain line of research.
Valdo Bardo
Nowadays there are more and more savages who cannot understand the significance of such research.
Valdo Bardo
Therefore, I have always desired skilled mercenaries at my side.
Valdo Bardo
If you will accept, please touch my illusion within the next minute.
Valdo Bardo
Should you do so, you will then be transported to the place where I currently reside.
Valdo Bardo
And in the unlikely event that you should refuse, you will be deemed to be thieves who have snuck into one of my homes.
Valdo Bardo
There is but one miserable fate awaiting thieves. I shall have to ask Draugr August to dispose of you.
Valdo Bardo
I hope you don't make such a foolish choice. So, what will you do now?
Sheesh, were all sorcerers as eccentric as this guy?
He booby traps his whole house, then turns around and tries to hire the very people who broke through them.
Just the idea alone was frighteningly elitist.
I got the feeling this sorcerer Valdo or whatever was more of the scheming evil type of guy if anything.
Kirara
...Haaaaaaaaaaaaahhh!!
Kirara-senpai let out a deep sigh that seemed to resound from the very depths of the earth.
She had already been trembling with rage from around the message's midpoint, but her face was telling me that she had finally reached her breaking point.
Kirara
Well that's just great!! How about we just have this guy transport us there so we can beat him to a pulp up close and personal?
Annreed
And if that in itself is the trap?
Chevalier
It's possible. If the destination takes us into the middle of a magma pool, then even Chevalier would most likely die.
Kirara
We're dealing with an overconfident sorcerer! There's no trap!
The three of them turned their gazes to me for my judgment.
I also thought the chances of it being a trap were low.
Deliberately following along with Valdo Bardo's proposal was one option that was available to us.
However, getting Hebiko and Shikanosuke back from the Guardian, Draugr August, was our top priority above all else right now.
That being the case, there was only one answer.
And so I responded to the illusory Valdo.
Me
We refuse.
Valdo Bardo
A pity.
Immediately after he said so without a hint of disappointment in his voice, the illusory Valdo's form transformed into Draugr August.
Draugr August
Seeing as I have my master's permission now, you shall all become materials for my own use.
Me
If you can beat us, that is. But if we beat you then we're going to have you return those two to us.
Me
Will you swear it on the name of your master, Valdo Bardo?
Draugr August
Very well. But I shan't let such a thing come to pass, fools who defy my master!
The eyes of the almighty Guardian, Draugr August, glinted ominously...
